name: Nakamori
source:
Specialty: Pottery
Hobby: Ships in a bottle
Likes: Curios
Dislikes: Trains

An older man who works as the curator of the Imperial Capital Museum. Never forgetting to always be polite, his gentleness brings to mind the image of an old, calm and collected gentleman. However, unable to keep up with the rapid progress of the modern world, he finds himself struggling with vehicles and high-tech machines.

[i]"Don't you think that time passes by too fast for people nowadays? Maybe it's because of this old body of mine… Haha."[i]
